# Synthetic US dataset (demo)

**Every company, person, domain, phone number and tax id here is invented.** Generated by
`uv run canon generate --profile west --out data/synthetic_west` (seeded; `tests/test_west.py` checks the committed
copy matches the generator). A fictional US software vendor ("Fieldstone Software, Inc.") and 25 customers with the
usual mess: duplicate CRM accounts, CRM values superseded by signed contracts, owner changes announced only in Slack,
look-alike companies, auto-renewal clauses with notice periods. `ground_truth/` is the answer key; only evaluation
code reads it. Use this dataset for demos to US and European buyers; `data/synthetic` (Moroccan, French/Arabic) remains
the main regression fixture.
